scanner_corrections.type: year-confusion (THIRD instance of open failure class)
scanner_corrections.detail: Scan claimed the 31 July 2026 Kyiv barrage killed 31 and injured 179. Contemporaneous reporting gives 3 killed in Kyiv and at least 9 nationwide. The 31/179 figures match the Kyiv strike of 31 July 2025, exactly one calendar year earlier.

Scan cited "377 killed, 2,129 wounded" for July 2026. The UN News source confirms the deadliest-month finding but does not carry those figures; it gives six-month totals of 1,396 killed and 7,978 injured. The July figures were EXCLUDED from scoring.

scanner_corrections.type: correction of a prior benchmark correction
scanner_corrections.detail: On 2026-08-01 the assessor corrected a claim that July 2026 was the worst month since 2022. UN News, dated 2026-08-05, states directly: "July marking the deadliest month for Ukrainian civilians since April 2022." The 2026-08-01 correction is superseded.

Scan dated the five-year protest to 1 August 2026. The rally was Saturday 25 July 2026, reported 26 July (Al Jazeera, Africanews). The cited 1 August Al Jazeera piece is an ANALYSIS article, not a report of an 1 August protest. Underlying event falls outside the 29 July window start.

Scan recorded the Science/Retraction Watch disclosure as 30 July 2026. The original exclusive was published 23 July 2026 (retractionwatch.com/2026/07/23/), outside the window; SJTU had confirmed its investigation by 27 July (HKFP). Only the 30 July escalation (Nature editor's note, formalised task force) is in-window.

Scan stated Amnesty International warned on 6 August 2026. The Amnesty page carries a publication date of 3 August 2026. The 6 August date belongs to a separate Al Jazeera analysis piece. Event date (clashes 1 August 2026) is correct.
Scan recorded evidence_date 2026-08-05. The CPJ report carries a publication date of 6 August 2026. Corrected evidence_date is 2026-08-06.

Scan evidence_date 2026-08-06 is CORRECT (Bloomberg and US News both date the DOJ announcement to 6 August 2026). The Fortune and WRAL URLs at 2026-08-07 are next-day coverage. Discrepancy resolved, no correction to the record required.
